problems.title: URL shortener (Bitly)
requirements: Create short links, redirect fast, optional alias and expiry
100:1 read to write ratio, low-latency redirects
design: Allocate numeric IDs in leased ranges, base62 encode (7 chars = 3.5 trillion codes)
Key-value store keyed by code; CDN + Redis in front of it
302 redirect if you need click counts, 301 to let browsers cache
Emit click events to a queue; aggregate asynchronously
deepDives: Scrambling IDs so codes are not enumerable
Hot link caching and stampede protection
Abuse: rate limits, malware scanning, takedown

problems.title: File sync (Dropbox)
requirements: Upload, download and sync files across devices
design: Presigned multipart uploads straight to object storage; metadata service in a DB
Split files into chunks, hash each, upload only missing chunks, keep a manifest
Notification channel tells clients about changes; clients pull a delta from a cursor
CDN for downloads with signed URLs
deepDives: Conflict resolution when two devices edit offline
Deduplication across users and encryption trade-offs
Rolling-hash chunking so a small edit changes few chunks

problems.title: Ticket booking (Ticketmaster)
requirements: Browse events and book seats; never double-sell
Massive spikes when popular events open
design: Reserve a seat with a TTL hold (Redis lock or DB row with expiry); confirm on payment
Strongly consistent store for inventory; cache for browsing
Virtual waiting room admits users at a controlled rate
Idempotent payment and booking flow
deepDives: Distributed lock vs DB constraint for seat holds

problems.title: News feed (Facebook)
requirements: Post and view a ranked feed of followed accounts
design: Hybrid fan-out: push for normal users, pull for celebrities
Per-user feed in Redis sorted sets of post ids; hydrate from post store
Async fan-out workers on a queue
Ranking service on top of candidate list
deepDives: Cache sizing and cold-start for inactive users

problems.title: Dating app (Tinder)
requirements: Show nearby candidate profiles; record swipes
Mutual like creates a match instantly
design: Geo-index (geohash/H3) of active users plus filters
Pre-generate and cache a candidate stack per user
Swipe writes to a partitioned log/store; match check via a lookup of the reverse swipe
Bloom filter to avoid showing already-seen profiles

problems.title: Coding contest platform (LeetCode)
requirements: Submit code, run against tests, return results
design: Submission API enqueues jobs; worker pool runs code in sandboxes (containers/gVisor/Firecracker) with CPU, memory, time, network limits
Results stored and pushed to the client via SSE/polling
Leaderboard in Redis sorted sets; periodic persistence
Autoscale workers on queue depth
deepDives: Contest burst traffic and fairness of judge timing

problems.title: Chat (WhatsApp)
requirements: 1:1 and group messaging with delivery receipts
Hundreds of millions of concurrent connections
design: Gateway fleet holding WebSockets; registry maps user to gateway
Server-assigned per-conversation sequence numbers for ordering
Store messages partitioned by conversation; clients sync after last seen seq
Push notifications for offline users; media via presigned uploads and CDN

problems.title: Rate limiter
problems.teaches: Algorithms, distributed counters, fail-open vs closed
requirements: Low added latency, works across many servers
design: Token bucket per key in Redis using an atomic Lua script
Gateway middleware returns 429 + Retry-After + headers
Rules service for per-tenant limits, cached locally
Local pre-limits plus global limits for cheap fast path

problems.title: Video streaming (YouTube)
requirements: Upload and stream video at many resolutions
design: Direct multipart upload to object storage; queue triggers transcoding workers (DAG: split, encode renditions, thumbnails)
Adaptive bitrate streaming (HLS/DASH) served via CDN
Metadata DB + search index; view counters aggregated asynchronously
Popular content pre-warmed at the edge
deepDives: Cost of transcoding and codec choices
Handling viral videos at the CDN

problems.title: Live comments
requirements: Comments appear for all viewers within a second
Streams with hundreds of thousands of viewers
design: Write comment to a log and recent-comments store; publish to a channel per stream
SSE connections to edge servers that subscribe to the channel
Batch and sample messages for huge rooms
Cursor-based catch-up on join
deepDives: Pub/sub fan-out tree through edge nodes

problems.title: Top-K videos / trending
requirements: Top K most viewed items per time window
design: Events to Kafka; stream processors keep Count-Min Sketch and a heap per window
Merge partial top-K from partitions
Serve results from a cache refreshed every few seconds
Batch job recomputes exact counts for correctness

problems.title: Ride hailing (Uber)
design: Driver locations in an in-memory geo-sharded store (H3 cells) with TTL
Matching service finds nearby available drivers, offers sequentially or in batches
Trip state machine with idempotent transitions persisted durably
Surge pricing from supply and demand per cell
deepDives: Failure of a matching shard mid-trip

problems.title: Web crawler
design: URL frontier with priority queues and per-host politeness queues
Fetcher fleet with DNS cache; parser extracts links
Bloom filter + content hash/SimHash for dedupe
Partition by host with consistent hashing; store pages in object storage

problems.title: Ad click aggregator
requirements: Count clicks per ad per minute accurately
design: Clicks to Kafka keyed by ad id; Flink aggregates in tumbling windows with watermarks
Idempotent writes to OLAP store (ClickHouse/Druid); dedupe by click id
Reconciliation batch job from raw log to fix drift
Hot-ad key splitting

problems.title: Post search
requirements: Full-text search across billions of posts
design: Change data capture feeds an indexing pipeline into Elasticsearch/OpenSearch shards
Query fan-out to shards, merge top-K
Permission filters at query time
Hot/cold tiers by recency

problems.title: Local business search (Yelp)
requirements: Search businesses by location and keyword
design: Search index with geo fields (geohash/geo_point) in Elasticsearch
Reviews in a relational store; ratings aggregated async
Cache popular queries by cell
Business data updated through CDC

problems.title: Photo sharing (Instagram)
design: Presigned uploads to object storage; async resize to several sizes
CDN for images; metadata in sharded DB
Hybrid fan-out feed
Counters (likes) via sharded or buffered counters

problems.title: Activity tracking (Strava)
requirements: Record GPS activities, upload later, segments and leaderboards
design: Clients batch GPS points and upload on connectivity; ingest via queue
Store raw tracks in object storage, summaries in DB
Segment matching via geospatial index offline
Leaderboards with sorted sets

problems.title: Distributed cache
requirements: Scale out/in with little data movement
design: Consistent hashing with virtual nodes; smart client or proxy routes requests
Replication for availability; LRU/LFU eviction with TTLs
Hot-key mitigation via local caches and replication
Gossip or coordination service for membership

problems.title: Online auction
requirements: Accept bids; highest valid bid wins; real-time updates
No lost or reordered bids at the end
design: Route all bids for an item through one partition/actor to serialize them
Optimistic check of current highest bid in the same transaction
Push updates via SSE/WebSocket; scheduled close with a durable timer
Sniping rules via time extensions
deepDives: Clock and ordering at auction end

problems.title: Job scheduler
requirements: Run jobs at times or intervals reliably
design: Jobs table partitioned by next-run time; scanners claim due jobs with leases
Queue to worker pool; heartbeats and visibility timeouts
Idempotent job handlers; retries and DLQ
Cron expressions computed to next run on completion
deepDives: Scanner sharding and thundering herd at :00

problems.title: News aggregator
requirements: Collect articles from many sources, group and rank
design: Source pollers/RSS + crawlers on a schedule
Dedupe/clustering with SimHash and embeddings
Index for search; ranking by recency and engagement
Per-user personalization layer

problems.title: Price tracking service
requirements: Track product prices, alert on drops
design: Scheduler assigns crawl frequency by popularity
Store price history in time-series store
Alert evaluator triggers on change events from a stream
Notification service with dedupe and rate caps

problems.title: Notification system
requirements: Push, email, SMS from many services
design: API with idempotency, preference check, templating
Per-channel, per-priority queues and worker pools
Provider adapters with rate limits and failover
Status callbacks and suppression lists

problems.title: Stock trading app (Robinhood)
problems.teaches: Order lifecycle, consistency, market data fan-out
requirements: Live quotes, place and track orders
design: Market data ingested then fanned out via pub/sub to WebSocket gateways
Order service as a durable state machine, idempotent submission to exchange
Ledger with double-entry for positions and cash
Reconciliation with broker/exchange reports

problems.title: Collaborative editor (Google Docs)
requirements: Many users edit the same document concurrently
Low latency, no lost edits, offline support
design: Operational transform with a central server or CRDT for convergence
WebSocket per document routed to the same server (sharded by doc id)
Append-only operation log + periodic snapshots
Presence and cursors as ephemeral state

problems.title: Payment system
requirements: Charge cards and pay out safely
design: Idempotency key stored with result; payment state machine
Double-entry immutable ledger
Outbox pattern for events; processor calls with their idempotency keys
Daily reconciliation against processor reports

problems.title: Metrics monitoring
requirements: Ingest millions of data points/s, query dashboards, alert
design: Agents push/pull to a gateway; Kafka buffers; write to time-series DB (compressed, partitioned by time)
Downsampling and retention tiers
Alert evaluator runs queries on schedule with dedupe and routing
Cardinality limits on labels
deepDives: Alert reliability when the monitor is down

problems.title: Online chess
design: Matchmaking queue by rating bands
Game server holds authoritative state per game; WebSocket per player
Moves validated server-side and appended to a log; clocks server-controlled
Spectators subscribe to a channel; persist finished games

problems.title: ChatGPT-style assistant
requirements: Streaming chat with history across models
Millions of users, cost control, abuse prevention
design: Stateless chat service builds prompts from stored history + memory, calls a router
Router uses queue-aware, prefix-affinity routing to GPU pools with continuous batching
SSE streaming; persist the final message asynchronously; resumable by message id
Token-based rate limits, moderation, model fallbacks, per-tenant spend caps

problems.title: Flash sale
requirements: Thousands of buyers for a few items at one instant
design: Waiting room/queue throttles entry; static content on CDN
Atomic inventory decrement in Redis; order creation async with idempotency
Reservation TTL then payment; release on timeout
Reconcile Redis and DB
deepDives: Hot key on a single SKU

technologies.title: Redis
technologies.what: Single-threaded in-memory store with rich types: strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, streams, bitmaps, HyperLogLog, geo.
useWhen: Pub/sub, lightweight queues, distributed locks with care
internals: Persistence by snapshots (RDB) and append-only log (AOF); replication is async
Cluster shards 16,384 hash slots across nodes
One command at a time per shard makes operations atomic
watchOut: Data bigger than RAM is expensive
Async replication can lose acknowledged writes on failover
Big keys and slow commands block the server

technologies.title: Elasticsearch / OpenSearch
technologies.what: Distributed search over Lucene inverted indexes with aggregations and near-real-time indexing.
internals: Index split into shards; shards have replicas; segments are immutable and merged
Queries fan out to shards and merge top-K
Refresh interval (about 1 s) controls visibility
watchOut: Not a primary source of truth
Too many small shards waste resources

technologies.title: Kafka
technologies.what: Durable, partitioned, replicated commit log for high-throughput streaming.
internals: Topics split into partitions; ordering is per partition
Consumer groups divide partitions; offsets track progress
Replication with in-sync replicas; acks=all for durability
watchOut: Consumer lag is the health signal; poison messages need DLQs

technologies.title: Temporal / durable execution
technologies.what: Runs long-lived workflows as code with automatic retries, timers and state recovery by replaying event history.
internals: Workflow code is deterministic; side effects live in activities
History events stored durably; workers poll task queues
Signals and queries interact with running workflows

technologies.title: API gateway
technologies.what: Single entry point handling routing, authentication, rate limiting, TLS, observability and request transformation.
internals: L7 proxy with plugin pipeline
Config pushed from a control plane
Often paired with a service mesh for east-west traffic
watchOut: Single point of failure if not redundant
Business logic creeping into the gateway

technologies.title: Cassandra / ScyllaDB
technologies.what: Masterless, linearly scalable store optimized for heavy writes and time-series-like access by partition key.
internals: LSM tree: commit log + memtable + SSTables + compaction
Consistent hashing ring; tunable consistency (ONE, QUORUM, ALL)
Query by partition key, then clustering columns
watchOut: No joins, limited ad hoc queries

technologies.title: DynamoDB
technologies.what: Fully managed, auto-scaling key-value store with single-digit millisecond latency.
internals: Partition key hashes to partitions; sort key orders items
Global secondary indexes for alternate queries
Conditional writes enable optimistic concurrency; streams for CDC
watchOut: Design for access patterns up front
Item size limit 400 KB; costs scale with throughput

technologies.title: PostgreSQL
technologies.what: Reliable ACID relational database with rich indexing, JSONB, extensions (pgvector, PostGIS).
internals: MVCC with snapshot isolation; autovacuum cleans old versions
WAL for durability and replication
B-tree, GIN, GiST, BRIN, HNSW indexes

technologies.title: Flink / stream processing
technologies.what: Processes unbounded event streams with event-time windows, state and exactly-once checkpoints.
internals: Event time and watermarks handle late data
Keyed state with periodic distributed snapshots
Windows: tumbling, sliding, session

technologies.title: ZooKeeper / etcd
technologies.what: Small, strongly consistent store used for leader election, configuration, locks and membership.
internals: Consensus (Zab / Raft) among 3-5 nodes
Watches notify clients of changes
Ephemeral keys vanish when a client's session dies
watchOut: Not for large or high-write data
